things.label: Air
things.description: The invisible moving world around us. It carries moisture and feeds a flame.

things.label: Fire
things.description: Heat and light. It cooks, hardens and changes materials rather than merely joining them.

things.label: Bowl
things.description: An open, hollow vessel with a broad mouth and a stable base.

things.label: Flour
things.description: Fine meal ground from grain. Loose and powdery until it is wetted.

things.label: Dough
things.description: A soft mass of flour and water. It can hold its shape, but has not yet risen or baked.

things.label: Plant fiber
things.description: Loose strands from plant stems. Flexible, but not yet organized into a strong length or sheet.

locations.label: Warm cellar
locations.description: A sheltered place for slow fermentation.
